other_conditions: Existing Khadi and Village Industry Institution (KVI) can apply if it has a positive balance sheet and assets, an artisan base of at least 200, sales turnover of at least ₹1.00 crore in each of the preceding three financial years, and an increase in the number of new artisans in the last three years.

Other institutions such as SPV, Society, Trust, Section 8 Company or LLP can apply if they have a Vision and Mission Board and Governing Structure with sufficient experience, a proper Management Information System (MIS), adequate financial resources (equity and debt), and demonstrated financial performance (profitability and IRR) for the last three years.

First‑time applicants can apply if they demonstrate highest commitment to social and rural upliftment, obtain funding commitment from scheduled commercial banks/NBFC/Venture Capital/Private Equity funds, have a proper MIS, and meet any additional criteria approved by the governing council.
Promoter must conduct a baseline survey identifying at least 200 members with Aadhaar numbers, with at least 50 % women.
Promoter must provide land of minimum 20,000 sq ft (up to 2 acres) either owned or on a long‑term lease of at least 15 years, and bear all related expenditures.

Promoter must deposit at least 15 % of the required working capital (or three months’ projected working capital) in a separate dedicated account after final selection and before the first fund release.
Promoter must form a Special Purpose Vehicle (SPV), preferably a Section‑8 Company or a Producer Company, before the release of the first installment of funds.
benefits_summary: Provides up to ₹9.599 crore subsidy per cluster covering capital subsidies for solar charkhas, looms, work sheds, solar grid, equipment, an 8 % interest subvention on working capital, and capacity‑building courses.
